metadata.title: Fix Multi-Track Export with Audio, Gaps, and Muting

story.iWant: to export my multi-track timeline with proper audio mixing, timeline gaps filled with black screens, and track muting controls
story.soThat: my exported video accurately reflects my timeline arrangement with correct audio and timing

tasks.task: Add track mute/volume state to types and store
Add explicit clip sorting before export
Create black screen generation for gaps
Modify single-track FFmpeg command to insert gaps
Modify multi-track FFmpeg command to insert gaps
Implement track mute handling in export
Implement configurable track volume in audio mixing
Write tests for multi-track audio export
Write integration tests for complete export flow
Manual testing with real timeline scenarios (QA)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Multi-track exports include audio from both unmuted tracks with proper mixing
Track 1 audio mixed at 100% volume, Track 2 audio mixed at configurable track volume
Mute button on timeline tracks is functional and toggles mute state visually
Muted tracks have their audio excluded from export (video-only export if all muted)
Timeline gaps between clips are filled with black screens and silent audio in export
All clips on timeline are exported in correct chronological order (explicitly sorted by startTime)
Export validation checks all clips have valid intermediate files before starting export
Export validation UI shows pre-export checklist (clips count, gaps detected, muted tracks, warnings)
Validation prevents export start if critical issues found (missing intermediate files, no clips)
All exports work correctly for: single-track, multi-track, with gaps, with muted tracks, and combinations

doc.title: Chop Shop - Decision Architecture
doc.snippet: Zustand for state management with immutability patterns. Main/renderer separation: FFmpeg runs only in main process. All file paths stored as absolute paths using path.join.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Editing & Export (MVP Checkpoint)
doc.snippet: ffmpeg.service.ts implements export pipeline: command building, child process execution, progress parsing. Export runs asynchronously with progress events to prevent UI blocking.

doc.title: Epic Technical Specification: Screen & Webcam Capture
doc.snippet: Two-track auto-placement: Track 1 for screen, Track 2 for webcam overlay. Reuses timelineStore.addClipToTrack() with no timeline extensions needed.

doc.title: Story 3.5: Export Timeline to MP4
doc.snippet: Original single-track export implementation with H.264 codec, CRF 18, resolution options (720p, 1080p, source). Uses FFmpeg filter_complex for video processing.

doc.title: Story 4.1: Multi-Track Timeline (2 Tracks)
doc.snippet: Track interface with id, clips array, height. Multi-track timeline supports Track 1 (main) and Track 2 (overlay). Clips can be distributed across tracks.

doc.title: Story 4.7: Enhanced Preview with Multi-Track Compositing
doc.snippet: VideoCompositor handles canvas-based multi-track rendering. PiP positioning for Track 2 overlays. Audio mixing with Web Audio API (Track 1 = 100%, Track 2 = 80%).

artifact.reason: Multi-track FFmpeg command builder with audio mixing bug (lines 1008-1024) using invalid 'copy' filter. Needs gap handling and mute support.
Single-track FFmpeg command builder. Needs gap detection and black screen insertion for timeline gaps.
Track interface definition. Needs extension with isMuted and volume properties for mute/volume control.
Zustand timeline state management. Needs new actions: toggleTrackMute(trackId), setTrackVolume(trackId, volume).
Export handler retrieves clips from tracks (lines 86-88). Needs explicit sorting, validation, and mute state passing to IPC.
Mute button UI (currently placeholder). Needs onClick handler connected to toggleTrackMute and visual state indicator.

node.package: Bundles FFmpeg 6.0 binaries for video processing
State management for timeline and track state
UI components for export validation and mute controls

constraints.constraint: Use functional programming patterns - avoid classes (CLAUDE.md guideline)
All functions must have JSDoc documentation with purpose and parameters
Files must not exceed 500 lines for AI tool compatibility
FFmpeg runs only in main process (ADR-002 security pattern)
Maintain Zustand immutability patterns in state updates
Use existing intermediate file workflow - no new encoding pipeline
Preserve existing H.264 export settings (CRF 18, slow preset)
Gap detection must handle trimmed clips correctly (duration - trimOut)
Black screen generation uses FFmpeg color filter (no memory allocation)
Audio mixing must respect track volume levels (Track 1: 100%, Track 2: configurable)
Validation UI must distinguish errors (red, blocks export) from warnings (yellow, allows proceed)
All paths in code must use project-relative format (strip project root prefix)

interface.name: Track (Extended)
interface.signature: interface Track { id: number; clips: Clip[]; height: number; isMuted: boolean; volume: number; }

interface.name: Gap
interface.signature: interface Gap { startTime: number; duration: number; position: number; }

interface.name: ExportValidationResult
interface.signature: interface ExportValidationResult { valid: boolean; errors: string[]; warnings: string[]; info: { clipCount: number; gapCount: number; mutedTracks: number[]; totalDuration: number; }; }

interface.name: generateBlackSegmentFilter
interface.signature: function generateBlackSegmentFilter(gapIndex: number, duration: number, width: number, height: number): { video: string; audio: string }

tests.standards: Jest testing framework (pre-configured in electron-react-boilerplate). Unit tests for pure functions (gap detection, filter generation). Integration tests for FFmpeg command building. Manual/E2E tests for actual exports. All tests use descriptive names following pattern: "should [expected behavior] when [condition]". Mock IPC channels for renderer component tests.
tests.locations: src/main/utils/__tests__/ (gap detection utilities) src/main/services/__tests__/ (FFmpeg service modifications) src/renderer/src/components/Timeline/__tests__/ (mute button UI) src/renderer/src/components/Export/__tests__/ (validation UI and logic) src/renderer/src/store/__tests__/ (timeline store actions)

ideas.idea: Test detectGaps() with: single gap, multiple gaps, no gaps, trimmed clips with gaps, overlapping clips (should return no gaps)
Test generateBlackSegmentFilter() returns correct FFmpeg syntax for video and audio streams
Test multi-track audio mixing: both tracks with audio → amix filter present, only track1 → direct routing, only track2 → direct routing, track1 muted → track2 only
Test muted track handling: track1 muted + track2 unmuted → only track2 audio in command, both muted → video-only export
Test clip sorting: unsorted clips [10s, 0s, 5s] → export command uses [0s, 5s, 10s] order
Test export validation: missing intermediate file → validation fails with error, all files present → validation passes, no clips → validation fails
Test validation UI: renders clip count, gap count, muted tracks; shows warnings in yellow, errors in red; disables export button on errors
Integration test: export single-track with gap → verify black screen inserted; export multi-track with both audio → verify mixing; export with muted track → verify audio excluded
